privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What data Ish Beruvchi collects, why, where it is stored and how you can control it.
privacy.intro: Ish Beruvchi is a platform that connects job seekers and employers. This policy applies equally to the website, the Android app and the Telegram bot and is based on the Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan "On Personal Data". By registering you consent to the processing of your personal data for the purposes described here.
sections: What we collect

- Account: phone number (required), first and last name or company name, chosen language. If you sign in with Telegram — your Telegram ID and username.
- Resume (entered by you): date of birth, gender, profession, experience, education, skills, languages, expected salary, photo and portfolio files.
- Location: region and district. If you tap "Detect my location" — your phone's GPS coordinates (only with your permission).
- Employers: company name, logo, address, tax ID (optional) and vacancies.
- Activity: applications, offers, chat messages, saved searches, AI search requests and notifications.
- Payments: amount, service, date and status. Card details stay with Payme/Click and never reach us.
- Technical: search queries (kept 90 days) and security logs.
We do not access your contacts, SMS, call log, camera or microphone. The app has no ads and no ad trackers.
Why we use it

- To create your account and sign you in.
- To show resumes and vacancies and calculate how well they match.
- To notify you about applications, interviews, matching vacancies and listing expiry (in the app and Telegram).
- To provide paid services and accept payments.
- To protect against fraud, spam and abuse.
We do not sell your data or share it with third parties for advertising.
Who sees your data

- While your job-seeker listing is active, employers can see your resume. You can hide it at any time.
- Your phone number is shown only as you choose: to employers you applied to, on request, or to everyone.
- Your exact GPS location is never shown: others only see the district and an approximate distance (whole km).
- Vacancies and company pages are public.
- Chat messages are visible only to the participants.
Service providers and where data is stored

The platform uses the following services. They process data only to provide their service:
- Supabase — database and files. Servers are located in India (Mumbai).
- Vercel — website hosting (global network).
- Telegram — sign-in and notifications.
- Payme and Click — payments (Uzbekistan).
- Anthropic (Claude) and Google (Gemini) — only to analyse the text you enter when you use AI features.
By registering you agree to the transfer of your data to these providers' servers, including outside Uzbekistan. If we move the data to servers in Uzbekistan, we will announce it on this page.
Retention

- Data is kept while your account is active.
- When you delete your account, your profile, resume, portfolio, applications, chats, AI searches and Telegram link are deleted.
- Payment records are kept without your name for financial reporting as required by law.
- Read notifications are deleted after 90 days, others after 180 days, unfinished Telegram bot dialogs after 30 days, search logs after 90 days.
Your rights

- View and correct your data — in "Profile".
- Hide your listing and control phone visibility — in "Settings".
- Withdraw consent and delete your account completely — see the "Account deletion" page.
- Stop Telegram notifications — by stopping or blocking the bot.
- For questions or complaints write to the address below — we reply within 10 business days.
Age limit
The platform is intended for users aged 16 and over. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 16; such accounts are deleted when found.
Security

All connections are encrypted (HTTPS). Access rights are enforced at the database level: each user sees only data they are allowed to see. Staff access data only for support and security, and such access is logged.
Changes
If the policy changes, we publish it on this page with the update date. We will also notify you about important changes in the app or Telegram.

deletion.title: Delete account
deletion.description: How to delete your “Ish Beruvchi” account and data.
deletion.intro: You can delete your account and its associated data yourself at any time. Deletion takes effect immediately and cannot be undone.
sections: Via the app or website

- Sign in to the “Ish Beruvchi” app or website.
- Open the “Settings” section.
- Tap the “Delete account” button.
- To confirm, type the word “DELETE” and tap “Delete permanently”.
If you can't sign in
Write to the address below from the phone number or Telegram account linked to your account — your account will be deleted within 7 days.
What is deleted

- Profile, resume, portfolio files.
- Applications, offers, conversations and notifications.
- Phone number and Telegram link.
- Active vacancies that belong only to you are closed.
What is kept

- Payment records (amount, date, service) — for financial reporting as required by law, without your name or profile.
- The “account deleted” entry in the security log.

terms.title: Terms of Use (public offer)
terms.description: Rules for using Ish Beruvchi, paid services, prices and refunds.
terms.intro: This document is a public offer between the Ish Beruvchi platform (website, Android app, Telegram bot) and the user. By registering or paying for a service you fully accept these terms.
sections: What the platform does

The platform connects job seekers and employers: listings, search, applications, chat and notifications. The platform is neither an employer nor a recruitment agency: hiring decisions and employment contracts are made between the employer and the job seeker.
Free services

- Viewing and searching vacancies and resumes.
- Applying, accepting offers and chat.
- Telegram notifications and resume builder.
Paid services and prices

- Publishing or extending a job-seeker listing: {price_worker_listing} UZS, {listing_days} days.
- Publishing or extending a vacancy: {price_vacancy_publish} UZS, {vacancy_days} days.
- Smart AI search (Telegram alert when a matching vacancy appears): {price_ai_alerts} UZS, {ai_days} days.
- Promotion: until {discount_until}, {discount_percent}% off the first payment for each listing type.
Prices are in Uzbek soum; the final amount is shown in the payment window. Price changes are announced on this page and do not affect services already paid for.
Payment

Payment is made via Payme or Click. The service activates automatically once payment is confirmed. When the term ends, the listing is removed from search automatically; we send a reminder beforehand. There are no automatic charges (no subscriptions) — you pay each time yourself.
Refunds

- Money charged but the service did not activate — full refund.
- Listing rejected by moderation, or service not provided due to the platform's fault — refund for unused days.
- If you stop the service yourself or tap "I found a job" after activation — no refund.
- No refund for a listing blocked for breaking the rules.
To request a refund write to the address below with your payment number — we review it within 10 business days. Money is returned to the card or wallet used for payment.
User obligations

- Provide only truthful information about yourself and your vacancy.
- One person or company — one account.
- You are responsible for the security of your account.
Prohibited

- Fake vacancies, fraud, pyramid schemes and multi-level marketing.
- Asking job seekers for money for employment, deposits or "document processing" fees.
- Discriminatory requirements based on gender, age, ethnicity, religion or disability (except where permitted by law).
- Advertising employment abroad without a licence.
- Offensive, obscene or illegal content, spam, posting on someone else's behalf.
- Mass harvesting of contacts from the platform (scraping).
Violating listings are removed and the account may be blocked.
Liability

The platform checks listings automatically and manually but cannot guarantee the accuracy of every piece of information users provide. Check the company before meeting and never pay in advance. Report suspicious listings with the "Report" button.
Disputes
Disputes are first resolved through negotiation: write to the address below. If no agreement is reached, the dispute is settled in court under the laws of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
Changes
If the terms change, they are published on this page with the update date. By continuing to use the platform after changes you accept the new terms.
